summary: Re-verified Daily.co video consultation fix. 12/12 tests in test_video_consultation.py now PASS (previously 11/12). The failing test `test_scheduled_appointment_persists_room_on_doc` — which exercises the exact 400 'already exists' path — passes with the new dual-check (409 OR 400+body match) in _daily_create_room (server.py:405-408). Added a dedicated rejoin regression test (test_video_rejoin_and_smoke.py::TestScheduledRejoinPersistsSameRoom) that books an appointment, joins video twice as patient, and asserts identical room_name + room_url on join #2 (no 502). Also asserts daily_room_name persisted on the appointment doc matches the returned room. Smoke tests for /api/, admin login, /api/doctors, /api/appointments all PASS. Combined: 17/17 green.

minor.issue: Doctors registered via /api/auth/register (role=doctor) do not appear in GET /api/doctors listing. Prevents end-to-end 'doctor joins appointment video as owner' test being asserted from a self-registered doctor account. Rejoin fix itself still fully validated via patient join #1 vs join #2 (same room_name/url, no 502). Consider auto-linking newly registered doctor users into the doctors collection, or documenting how a doctor account becomes a listed doctor.

action_items: Fix verified — no further action required for the room-already-exists bug.

Optional: expose self-registered doctor accounts via GET /api/doctors so that an end-to-end multi-role rejoin test (patient + doctor on the same appt) can be asserted automatically instead of falling back to informational logging.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:405-408 — good defensive dual-check (status_code == 409 OR (400 AND 'already exists' in body)). Body match is case-insensitive via .lower(). Safe against upstream API variants.
On duplicate, server does GET /rooms/{room_name} and returns the fetched room JSON — correct behaviour: idempotent room provisioning, preserves persisted daily_room_name on the appointment doc.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Video consultation is fully working. The Daily.co 400 'already exists' branch is exercised on every patient rejoin (test_video_consultation.py::test_scheduled_appointment_persists_room_on_doc + test_video_rejoin_and_smoke.py::test_rejoin_patient_twice_same_room). If you regress the check in _daily_create_room (server.py:405-418), both tests will fail with a 502. Self-registered doctor accounts are not listed in /api/doctors — so the doctor-owner leg of the rejoin test currently logs an [INFO] instead of asserting; wire that up if the doctor-listing behaviour changes.
rca_of_issue: Original bug (iteration 7): Daily.co returns HTTP 400 with body 'already exists' (not 409) when a room name is duplicate. The old code only checked `r.status_code == 409`, so on the second video/session call for the same appointment_id it would fall through to `if r.status_code >= 400: raise HTTPException(502, ...)`. Fix (server.py:405-408): recognise BOTH 409 AND (400 + 'already exists' in body.lower()) as duplicate signal, then GET the existing room and return it. Verified: patient join #2 now returns 200 with identical room_name + room_url; appointment doc retains the persisted daily_room_name; no 502.
